body.objective: Construct the missing exact map from the positive-mixed replacement Phi2 retained harmonic basis to the local Berger component-jet basis used by the universal unary formulas, and evaluate the previously undefined nonrod D3S corrections.
body.stop_condition: Import BERGER_REPLACEMENT_112_POSITIVE_MIXED_ACTION_UNARY and BERGER_REPLACEMENT_112_EXECUTABLE_UNARY_VARIATIONAL_INPUT_SHORTFALL by content hash.  Declare the Berger orthonormal/coframe convention, retained harmonic basis, local tensor-component ordering, covariant derivative convention and every jet label consumed by the old universal q1 formulas.  Derive a sparse exact retained-basis-to-component-jet linear map through the highest derivative order needed by D3S, including connection terms, reality and K_Berger weights.  Apply it to the positive-mixed Phi2 primitive and export every evaluated changed nonrod unary coefficient with its source retained coefficient and derivative path.  Verify the map by exact harmonic projection/reconstruction, covariant commutator identities, real/K covariance and agreement of overlapping unchanged rows with the executable 108-row control.  A method-distinct rail must derive the decisive changed D3S entries directly from the action Hessian or an independent tensor-variation route.  If a retained mode lacks enough geometric metadata, emit the smallest missing harmonic-profile contract rather than assigning a local jet by name.
body.current_gate: positive-mixed Phi2 retained-harmonic to local component-jet map
body.forbid: no point-sampled interpolation called an exact jet map; no old Phi2 component values substituted for changed retained coefficients; no connection terms dropped; no row-name or symmetry guess; no 112/160-row cohomology, q2, Z2, redshift or memory promotion; no identical producer and verifier differentiation path
activates: replacement-112 executable unary export with evaluated nonrod D3S rows
body.resource_hint: OBSERVER GEOMETRIC PRODUCER.  This is a finite exact tensor/harmonic map; use Forge tensor/harmonic or differential-PBW kernels as an independent rail where possible.
notes: Success supplies only the missing variational input.  The full replacement unary and 160-row pushout must still be reconstructed and checked afterward.
